newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CSN begun as a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CSN begun as a buy.

text.p: -- ING Barings said in a report that it is initiating coverage of Brazilian steelmaker Companhia Siderurgica Nacional (CSN) with a buy recommendation.
-- The Dutch investment bank said the company's aggressive cost-reduction plan, coupled with gains from privatization in the infrastructure sectors, should boost margins in 1997 and 1998.
-- It added that the company plans to focus its investments on the development of more value-added products, especially in the galvanized and tin plate lines.
-- Although the bank disagreed with some of CSN's recent acquisitions, it considers its expected participation in the sale of state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce
-- CSN's voting common share was flat at Friday's closing price of 28.70 reais at 1302 local/1002 EST on the Sao Paulo stock market.
